text:
garrett: quick decision point for saved per-route analytics views that filter by model: should a saved view capture an explicit routing_spec (region/tier/fallbacks) or treat routing as a runtime policy? reproducibility vs rollout fragility. cc @leah @oscar

leah: lean runtime-policy by default. infra teams change pools frequently; hard snapshots will lead to stale saved views. but we should allow an opt-in snapshot for reproducibility.

oscar: agree on opt-in. UX-wise, add a checkbox in the save modal: "Capture execution environment (region/tier & perf estimate)". If checked we store a tiny snapshot string.

tina: telemetry note: whatever we do, the apply-time event must include both the stored snapshot (if any) and the resolved routing that actually executed. add fields: saved_view_applied -> [saved_view_id, user_id, snapshot_present, snapshot_str, resolved_routing_ref, model_rev, effective_sample_rate].

garrett: thinking of a compact saved object shape: keep DB column small, e.g. store snapshot as compact string like "eu-west-1|dedicated-mid|hint-55|tok=1100|lat=150" and a policy enum: "policy: live|snapshot|prefer_snapshot". saved object example in DB: `v=1|route=r_31|model=open-13b@r2026|filters=status:error|snapshot=<opt_str>|policy=prefer_snapshot|sample=0.05`.

leah: great. UI preview should always show two rows: "Snapshot (saved)" and "Current resolve (live)", with a small cost/latency delta. if they differ show a yellow badge: "resolution drift" and a short explainer.

oscar: migration: backfill existing saved views by calling resolver at low QPS to synthesize snapshot only for items flagged by a new "capture_env" bit. For older saves leave policy=live. We'll do background idempotent writes.

tina: also add event saved_view_previewed when users open the preview; include preview_mode and whether snapshot vs live differ. we need that to measure user confusion.

garrett: fallback rules if snapshot requested but unavailable: try snapshot -> route-default -> cheapest-compatible. UI must show why fallback happened and offer a button to re-apply live or queue a retry. Emit saved_view_fallback event with reason code.

leah: implementation note: resolver should return a stable routing_ref id (immutable pointer) for telemetry. preview cost/latency estimation should use cached perf_profiles per model to avoid calling slow profilers during UI open.

oscar: let's gate live-resolve preview behind a feature flag; A/B 10% initial rollout to measure resolver latency impact and error surface. we'll ramp after metrics look stable.

tina: sampling: store sampling_owner (route|view|global) and sampling_rate as float 0..1 on the saved object and include in saved_view_applied so analytics can reweight.

ops-bot: queued: saved-view-migration-job @3587654370 (job/12021).

garrett: owners: oscar -> API + resolver + migration job; tina -> telemetry events + analytics dashboards; leah -> UX copy + preview mock; garrett -> rollout checklist + feature flag. I'll capture decisions in INF-7832. Thanks all.
